material: Pure PEDOT:PSS hydrogel (13 vol.% DMSO, dry-annealed and rehydrated)

formulation.evidence: The pure PEDOT:PSS hydrogels with the optimized amount of DMSO (13 vol.%) and annealing condition (three cycles of 30 min annealing at 130 °C)
PEDOT:PSS aqueous solution (1.1–1.3% solid content, Clevios™ PH1000, Heraeus Electronic Materials) was stirred vigorously for 6 h

processing.evidence: dried at 60 °C for 24 h followed by multiple cycles of annealing at 130 °C (three cycles with 30 min per each cycle) to yield pure PEDOT:PSS films
dried at 60 °C for 24 h followed by multiple cycles of annealing at 130 °C (three cycles with 30 min per each cycle) to yield pure PEDOT:PSS films
multiple cycles of annealing at 130 °C (three cycles with 30 min per each cycle)
Upon further stirring for 24 h at room temperature, the mixed solution was solvent-casted directly onto poly￾propylene (PP) or polyethylene terephthalate (PET) substrate
the dry-annealed PEDOT:PSS can be facilely converted into stable pure PEDOT:PSS hydrogels by rehydrating in water or in PBS

youngs_modulus.evidence: ~40 S cm−1 in deionized water, as well as low Young’s modulus of ~2 MPa and high stretchability of over 35% strain in wet physiological environments

conductivity.evidence: the highest conductivity of ~20 S cm−1 in PBS and ~40 S cm−1 in deionized water achieved at 13 vol.% DMSO concentration

description.evidence: high CIC value of 8.3 mC cm−2 and stability (less than 10% change after 20,000 cycles) in PBS

notes: Optimized formulation; conductivity by four-point probe on hydrated samples; tensile tests on fully swollen dog-bone films submerged in PBS or DI water. CSC/CIC measured on Pt electrode in PBS.
